test: add DefaultRequestHandler integration test for DatabaseTaskStore (#800)

Supersedes #757.

This replaces the separate delayed-store suite with a single integration
test verifying `DefaultRequestHandler` with `DatabaseTaskStore` and the
default `ExecutionEventBus`.

The test lives in `describeDatabaseTaskStoreBehavior`
(`test/support/database/database_task_store_behavior.ts`), so it runs
across all supported database engines without duplicating the existing
store or E2E suites. It exercises a `sendMessage` lifecycle (`task` ->
`statusUpdate` with agent message -> `artifactUpdate` -> terminal
`statusUpdate`) and verifies both the persisted state via `store.load()`
and retrieval via `handler.getTask()`.
